name: Marko Babić
bio:
Marko's journey into the fast-paced world of motorsport finance began with a childhood fascination for racing simulators and a knack for numbers. He earned a degree in Economics from the University of Zagreb, specializing in financial analysis and risk management. While studying, he volunteered at a local karting track, managing their budget and sponsorship accounts, which solidified his ambition to combine his passions. 

Marko is known for his meticulous approach to financial control, implementing innovative strategies to optimize resource allocation and maximize profitability within racing teams. He is particularly adept at forecasting revenue streams and cost management, ensuring sustainable financial health for motorsport ventures. 

His demanding personality pushes those around him to achieve peak performance, but his ultimate goal is always to secure the financial stability and long-term success of the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted with a slight wave
physical.description: Marko is of average height with a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a lucky Croatian Kuna coin.
Meticulously cleans his workspace at the end of each day.
Has a habit of tapping his pen when deep in thought.
